title: %arrayblit between float arrays keeps a local box for each element at -Oclassic
summary: At `-Oclassic`, `%arrayblit` between two float arrays allocates a boxed float on the local stack for each element and keeps them until the copy ends. Copying 10,000,000 elements grows the local stack to 256 MB; under `ulimit -v 450000` the program ends with `Local allocation stack overflow`.

actual.text: Prints `Fatal error: Local allocation stack overflow - out of memory`; exit status 134.

cause: `middle_end/flambda2/from_lambda/lambda_to_lambda_transforms.ml`, `arrayblit_expanded`, reads the source element with a local allocation that Simplify is expected to remove; at `-Oclassic` it stays.
